# results/

This folder receives all outputs generated by `LCA\_Analyses.R`. Its contents
are excluded from version control (see `.gitignore`) because they are fully
reproducible by running the script.

\---

## Generated files

After a complete run of `LCA\_Analyses.R`, this folder will contain:

### Excel tables

|File|Section|Description|
|-|-|-|
|`removal\_log.xlsx`|§5|Participant exclusion log with reasons|
|`descriptive\_statistics.xlsx`|§6|Sample characteristics table|
|`LCA\_fitindices\_DA.xlsx`|§7|LCA fit indices (K = 1–10) — DA sample|
|`LCA\_fitindices\_L.xlsx`|§7|LCA fit indices (K = 1–10) — L sample|
|`LCA\_classtable\_DA.xlsx`|§7|Conditional probabilities by class — DA sample|
|`LCA\_classtable\_L.xlsx`|§7|Conditional probabilities by class — L sample|
|`primary\_regression\_results.xlsx`|§8|OLS regression results (unadjusted)|
|`sensitivity\_regression\_results.xlsx`|§9|OLS regression results (covariate-adjusted)|

### Figures (PNG, 300 dpi)

|File|Section|Description|
|-|-|-|
|`LCA\_elbowplot\_DA.png`|§7|BIC, AIC, entropy, BLRT by K — DA sample|
|`LCA\_elbowplot\_L.png`|§7|BIC, AIC, entropy, BLRT by K — L sample|
|`LCA\_profileplot\_DA.png`|§7|Conditional probability profile plot — DA sample|
|`LCA\_profileplot\_L.png`|§7|Conditional probability profile plot — L sample|
|`primary\_regression\_coef\_DA.png`|§8|Coefficient plot (unadjusted) — DA sample|
|`primary\_regression\_coef\_L.png`|§8|Coefficient plot (unadjusted) — L sample|
|`sensitivity\_regression\_coef\_DA.png`|§9|Coefficient plot (adjusted) — DA sample|
|`sensitivity\_regression\_coef\_L.png`|§9|Coefficient plot (adjusted) — L sample|

### Reproducibility

|File|Section|Description|
|-|-|-|
|`sessionInfo.txt`|§10|Full R session information (R version, OS, package versions)|

\---

## Reproducing the outputs

```r
# From the project root directory:
source("LCA\_Analyses.R")
```

See the main `README.md` for system requirements and computation time notes.
